Name: Measures must have a description
Description: Descriptions appear as tooltips in the field list and feed the data dictionary and Copilot. Add a /// line above the measure in TMDL.

Name: Measures must be organised in a display folder
Description: Keeps the field list navigable as the model grows.

Name: Visible measures must have a format string
Description: Every KPI should render consistently in every visual. Use a static formatString or a formatStringDefinition. Text measures can opt out with the BestPracticeAnalyzer_IgnoreRules annotation.

Name: Use DIVIDE() instead of the / operator
Description: DIVIDE handles division by zero and blank denominators safely.

Name: Avoid IFERROR / ISERROR
Description: Error handling in DAX forces cell-by-cell evaluation. Fix the data or use DIVIDE instead.

Name: Hide foreign key columns
Description: Users should filter through dimension attributes, not fact-table keys.
Expression: UsedInRelationships.Any(FromColumn.Name == current.Name and FromColumn.Table.Name == current.Table.Name and FromCardinality.ToString() == "Many") and not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden

Name: Avoid bi-directional relationships
Description: Bi-directional filters cause ambiguity and slow queries. Use CROSSFILTER in a specific measure if really needed.

Name: Avoid floating-point data types
Description: Use Fixed Decimal (decimal) for money and Int64 for counts. Floating point is only acceptable for coordinates.

Name: Visible numeric columns must not summarise implicitly
Description: Attributes like Year or Age must not be summed by default. Aggregations belong in measures.
Expression: not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden and SummarizeBy.ToString() != "None" and (DataType.ToString() == "Int64" or DataType.ToString() == "Decimal" or DataType.ToString() == "Double")

Name: Visible objects must use friendly names
Description: Rename snake_case source columns in the model (sourceColumn keeps the warehouse name).
Expression: not IsHidden and not Table.IsHidden and Name.Contains("_")

Name: The model must have a marked date table
Description: Time-intelligence functions and the Time Intelligence calculation group need one.
Expression: not Tables.Any(DataCategory == "Time" and Columns.Any(IsKey and DataType.ToString() == "DateTime"))

Name: Disable auto date/time
Description: Auto date/time adds a hidden table per date column. Use the Date dimension instead.

Name: Month and weekday names need a sort-by column
Description: Without it they sort alphabetically (April, August, ...).
Expression: DataType.ToString() == "String" and (Name.Contains("Month") or Name.Contains("Day of Week")) and SortByColumn == null

Name: Date columns must have a format string
Tables should have a description
Description: Explain grain and source (dbt model) for every table.

Name: Object names must not start or end with a space
Description: Leading/trailing spaces make DAX references error-prone.
